what: On hover a panel in the button’s opposite color enters from outside the right (110%) tilted 30° over .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), covers straight, and the text color flips. On release the panel exits to outside the left (−110%) tilted −30° in .3s ease-out, then after .4s snaps back to its right-side start with no transition — a hover re-entered in between waits .4s before coming in

options.look: light: White button + black panel (on dark background)
options.look: ghost: Transparent button + thin frame, panel fills the frame
options.hold: Time to return to place after leaving (s), default .4
options.area: Ancestor selector that measures the interaction — hovering the whole card fills the button inside

from.where: shared.css .r-btn — MORE · READ (black) · ABOUT US (white, on a dark panel) · Product Page (outline only)
